subject: Nicotinamide riboside and hard training remodelled muscle epigenetics differently
script: From Agewell Brief: Nicotinamide riboside and hard training remodelled muscle epigenetics differently. A new RCT reveals that nicotinamide riboside and high-intensity exercise remodel the muscle epigenome differently—what that means for cellular voltage and healthspan. Skeletal muscle is not just a motor; it's a metabolic organ whose epigenetic state tracks biological age. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
